text: Montella is a bottled drinking-water brand of Navruz International Corp., a joint Uzbek-American LLC founded in March 2003 that produces soft drinks and bottled water in the Tashkent region.
short: Montella is a Navruz International Corp. brand.

source.name: Navruz International Corp.: 'О компании'
source.quote: Совместная Узбекско — Американская компания СП ООО «Navruz International Corp.» была основана в марте 2003 года
source.note: The same page says production of the bottled water brand «Montella» was launched in 2009-2010 ('бутилированной воды «Montella»').
